comparison.objective: Insert both ends of a long lamp tube into sockets and rotate it to detent-lock; candidate tunes and locks a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires bimanual long-object support, simultaneous dual-end insertion, coordinated quarter-turn rotation, and release. Candidate requires fine hex engagement, captive-screw manipulation, small-collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and iterative response testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both pin pairs in pockets, both detents engaged near 90°, grippers clear, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires two repeated safe carriage stops with no bottoming, overload, rebound, damage, tool loss, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both include rotation followed by locking, but dual-end lamp installation and feedback-based damper commissioning test meaningfully different physical abilities.
